d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how, in a major geopolitical turnaround, Eastern Libya’s parliament has unanimously ratified a controversial maritime boundary agreement with Turkey, fully reversing its 2020 decision to sever diplomatic ties with Ankara. Originally signed in 2019 by Tripoli’s Western-based administration, the pact redefines Mediterranean maritime jurisdictions to expand energy and economic rights.
